newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Alpha Health says Berjaya to up stake.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Alpha Health says Berjaya to up stake.

text.p: Alpha Healthcare Ltd said on Tuesday that Malaysia's Berjaya Group Bhd would lift its stake in Alpha to nearly 20 percent from from 13.1 percent.
Alpha said the increase would be satisfied by a placement of 9.55 million Alpha shares to Berjaya to raise A$1.91 million.
The placement is subject to the approval of the Australian government's Foreign Investment Review Board (FIRB).
Alpha said the strengthening of the relationship with Berjaya was the most significant development for the company since its restructuring in late 1994.

Berjaya has extensive interests in private hospitals including a 24 percent interest in Asia's largest hospital group, Parkway Holdings, and a 50 percent stake in Australian private pathology group Gribbles Pathology.

"The additional investment by Berjaya will enable Alpha to accelerate its expansion into other health services such as primary care, pathology, occupational rehabilitation and radiology and complements its existing hospital ownership and management business," Alpha managing director Paul Hopper said.

Hopper said Berjaya's ancillary services were expected to account for an additional 33 percent of its gross revenue base by the end of calendar year 1996 and were expected to grow at a faster rate than its establishment hospital business and provide a diversity of income stream for Alpha.
Alpha shares closed a cent weaker at 18.5 cents on Tuesday.
